description: Flat metadata schema for fecal metagenomic samples from mammalian hosts used to study how host factors and geography shape gut microbiome composition and function.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample/record.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the sample to the parent study or project.

host_common_name.descr: Common name of the mammalian host (for example: mouse, rat, macaque, pig, cow, dog, cat).

host_scientific_name.descr: Full binomial taxonomic name of the host species (for example: Mus musculus, Macaca mulatta).

host_taxon_id.descr: NCBI Taxonomy ID or equivalent stable taxonomic identifier for the host species.

host_order.descr: Taxonomic order of the host (for example: Rodentia, Primates, Carnivora, Artiodactyla).

host_family.descr: Taxonomic family of the host, if known.

host_breed_or_strain.descr: Breed, strain, or subspecies of the host when relevant (for example: C57BL/6, Holstein, Labrador).

host_sex.descr: Biological sex of the host; expected values include male, female, unknown, or intersex if applicable.

host_age.descr: Age of the host at sampling, in years or months as recorded; use numeric value only and standardize unit in a separate field.

host_age_unit.descr: Unit for host_age; expected values include years, months, weeks, or days.

host_life_stage.descr: Life stage of the host at sampling; for example neonate, juvenile, adult, aged, unknown.

diet_type.descr: Primary diet category of the host at sampling; for example herbivore, carnivore, omnivore, omnivorous-captive, high-fiber, high-fat, mixed, unknown.

diet_detail.descr: More specific diet description or feeding regimen, including notable components, if available.

health_status.descr: Clinical or general health status of the host at sampling; for example healthy, diseased, treated, carrier, unknown.

diagnosis_or_condition.descr: Specific diagnosis, condition, or phenotype if health status is not healthy; use standardized disease/condition naming when possible.

antibiotic_exposure.descr: Whether the host received antibiotics within a relevant pre-sampling window; expected values true or false.

other_treatment_exposure.descr: Whether the host received other medications, probiotics, antiparasitics, or veterinary treatments relevant to microbiome composition; expected values true or false.

host_living_environment.descr: Living setting of the host; for example wild, captive, farm, household, zoo, laboratory, semi-wild.

host_social_group_size.descr: Approximate number of conspecifics in the host's social group or housing cohort when available.

sample_material.descr: Biological material collected; expected value for this study is feces or fecal swab, as applicable.

sample_collection_method.descr: Method used to collect the sample, for example direct fecal pickup, rectal swab, enclosure collection, or opportunistic field collection.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) when available.

collection_time_local.descr: Local time of sample collection if recorded, preferably in 24-hour HH:MM:SS format.

sample_preservation_method.descr: How the sample was preserved after collection, for example frozen at -80 C, RNAlater, ethanol, dry ice, immediate extraction.

time_to_freezing_hours.descr: Time elapsed between collection and freezing or stabilization, in hours.

extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction method or kit used, including key protocol name if applicable.

library_prep_method.descr: Sequencing library preparation protocol or kit used.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, for example Illumina NovaSeq, MiSeq, NextSeq, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy, for example shotgun metagenomics, paired-end shotgun, long-read metagenomics.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs for short-read data, if applicable.

paired_end.descr: Whether sequencing produced paired-end reads; expected values true or false.

target_depth_mbp.descr: Approximate sequencing depth per sample in megabase pairs or equivalent project-specific target if specified.

barcode_or_index_id.descr: Sample barcode, index, or multiplex identifier used during sequencing/library preparation.

fastq_files.descr: Paths, accessions, or identifiers for raw sequencing FASTQ files associated with the sample.

assembly_accession.descr: Identifier for any assembled metagenome generated from this sample, if applicable.

biosample_accession.descr: BioSample accession or equivalent repository identifier.

sra_accession.descr: Sequence Read Archive accession or equivalent raw-read repository identifier.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

region.descr: State, province, region, or administrative division of collection, if available.

locality.descr: City, town, site name, reserve, farm, facility, or other specific collection locality.

latitude.descr: Latitude of collection site in decimal degrees, if available.

longitude.descr: Longitude of collection site in decimal degrees, if available.

altitude_m.descr: Collection-site altitude in meters above sea level, if available.

latitude_precision_deg.descr: Reported uncertainty or precision for latitude in decimal degrees, if known.

longitude_precision_deg.descr: Reported uncertainty or precision for longitude in decimal degrees, if known.

habitat_type.descr: Environmental habitat associated with the host or sampling site, for example forest, urban, pasture, agricultural, laboratory, zoo enclosure.

temperature_c.descr: Ambient or habitat temperature at collection, in degrees Celsius, if recorded.

humidity_percent.descr: Ambient relative humidity at collection, in percent, if recorded.

notes.descr: Free-text notes for any additional relevant contextual information not captured by other fields.
